detail.longDescription: I built an open source python dependency scanner that will scan and flag packages with known exploit CVEs(CISA's Known Exploited list and FIRST EPSS) and unmaintained packages that have not had a release or commit in 2 years. Theres also claude hook that will make your AI agent not install these type of packages included in this repo. The full mechanism is in the readme of the project, this was just a brief summary.
